messages:
joel_sales: BankBridge asking if we can do a 10-day air-gapped POC. Key asks: signed bundle with SBOM, USB-friendly chunked bundles (resume-able), offline license activation file, and a fixed monthly price for a 3-GPU reserved offline pool. Also wants rollback docs for sneakernet installs.

anya_se: We can produce a versioned bundle (bundle-v1.tar.gz), a bundle_manifest.json (with per-file sha256), and a detached signature bundle.sig. For chunked transfer we support chunked archives (chunk_000..chunk_N) with an index file so transfers can resume. No infra change needed if they re-sign locally.

marco_sre: Rollback: supported if they keep previous bundle tarballs and index. We recommend retaining last 2 bundles. Maintenance windows: small patch (single chunk) ~20-45m; full rollouts 1.5-4h depending on disk copy speed. For USBs add an extra 30-90m for manual validation.

sumi_security: BankBridge requires FIPS-compatible signing and an auditable signing event. If they want vendor to sign into their HSM (customer-provided), we need a PS engagement. For customer-side re-signing we provide verification + attestation guidance.

joel_sales: They specifically asked if we can provide a time-limited signing cert and an attestation report that shows bundle provenance at handoff. Can we do that?

anya_se: We can emit a handoff artifact: handoff.json containing build id, git commit, SBOM digest, and a timestamped signing cert chain (PEM). Time-limited certs are doable (short-lived signing cert) but require ops to coordinate key escrow or an HSM proxy. PS ~2 days to wire a one-off short-lived-certs flow if they want Redwood to orchestrate.

marco_sre: On resume-able chunks: plan to include a small verify utility that validates all chunks and reassembles the archive, plus a manifest pointer for rollback. We'll include checks for disk space and atomic swap strategy in the runbook.

joel_sales: Pricing: can we give a ballpark for 3-GPU offline reserved pool? Need to include offline ops support and one PS line for possible HSM work.

marco_sre: Ballpark: base reserved offline pool (3 GPU-eq) = $XXk/month + offline support add-on $Yk/month + PS for HSM/task ~Zk one-time. I'll DM precise numbers.

sumi_security: I'll draft security questionnaire answers: supported signing modes = (1) customer re-sign, (2) Redwood signs using customer HSM (audited), (3) vendor-signed with exported attestation. Also include FIPS wording and rotation cadence.

deploy-bot: Ticket SALES-12177 created: "BankBridge air-gapped POC : chunked bundles, signing certs, offline pricing" by joel_sales.

joel_sales: Actions: anya -> verify + reassembly script + example cosign commands by Wed EOD; marco -> runbook excerpt (chunk table, maintenance windows, rollback steps) by Wed EOD; sumi -> questionnaire + attestation wording by Wed EOD. Aim to send to customer Thu morning.

anya_se: On it. I'll attach a tiny verify.sh and sample cosign invocation.

marco_sre: I'll include sample bandwidth estimates for USB speeds (e.g., 2GB, 8GB, 30GB) and recommended chunk sizes.

sumi_security: Looping legal for FIPS attestation language now.

joel_sales: Thanks team, will update CRM and attach SALES-12177.
